rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice when something cannot be resisted, such as a temptation or offer.

example.english: This bargain-priced shirt is irresistible to me.
example.traditional: 呢件咁平嘅衫，我真係抗拒唔到。
example.jyutping: nei1 gin6 gam3 peng4 ge3 saam1 ngo5 zan1 hai6 kong3 keoi5 m4 dou2

rows.note: Use this when irresistible means compellingly attractive or appealing, rather than literally impossible to resist.

example.english: That newly opened café is irresistible.
example.traditional: 嗰間新開嘅咖啡店裝修好吸引。
example.jyutping: go2 gaan1 san1 hoi1 ge3 gaa3 fe1 dim3 zong1 sau1 hou2 kap1 jan5
